title: Oven Roasted Irish Lamb Wrap
description: A romantic Irish dish featuring tender lamb, sweet red onions, and a hint of cure, all wrapped in a buttery corn husk wrap. This high-protein-friendly meal is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the melted butter, cure, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb shoulder on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes per pound, or until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the corn husks by soaking them in water for at least 30 minutes.
Once the lamb is cooked, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
To assemble the wraps, lay a corn husk flat on a work surface and arrange a few slices of the lamb down the center of the husk.
Top the lamb with a few slices of red onion and fold the sides of the husk over the filling, then roll the wrap up tightly.
